rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Biotechnology Promotion Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Biotechnology Promotion Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Requirements for Designation of Specialized Biotechnology Policy Agency) Pursuant to Article 24, Paragraph 1 of the Biotechnology Promotion Act, the Minister of Science and ICTmay designate an institution or organization that meets all of the requirements of each of the following subparagraphs as a specialized biotechnology policy agency.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Requirements for Designation of Specialized Biotechnology Policy Agency) Pursuant to Article 24, Paragraph 1 of the Biotechnology Promotion Act, the Minister of Science and ICT may designate an institution or organization that meets all of the requirements of each of the following subparagraphs as a specialized biotechnology policy agency.

rows.source_ko: 1. The business activities of the relevant institution or organization must include work related to biotechnology policy support.
rows.text_en: 1. The business activities of the relevant institution or organization must include work related to biotechnology policy support.

rows.source_ko: 2. Possess a dedicated organization capable of performing the duties specified in each subparagraph of Article 24, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Biotechnology Promotion Act and at least 7 dedicated personnel.
rows.text_en: 2. Possess a dedicated organization capable of performing the duties specified in each subparagraph of Article 24, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Biotechnology Promotion Act and at least 7 dedicated personnel.

rows.source_ko: 3. Must be equipped with dedicated workspaces and facilities necessary for performing the duties specified in each subparagraph of Article 24, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Biotechnology Promotion Act.
rows.text_en: 3. Must be equipped with dedicated workspaces and facilities necessary for performing the duties specified in each subparagraph of Article 24, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Biotechnology Promotion Act.

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Review of Regulations) The Minister of Science and ICT shall review the validity of the requirements for designation of a specialized biotechnology policy agency under Article 2 every three years starting from January 1, 2024 (meaning before January 1 of every third year) and take measures such as improvements.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Review of Regulations) The Minister of Science and ICT shall review the validity of the requirements for designation of a specialized biotechnology policy agency under Article 2 every three years starting from January 1, 2024 (meaning before January 1 of every third year) and take measures such as improvements.

rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on August 14, 2024.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on August 14, 2024.
